name: Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM)
description_en:
Coevera is the current name of Pipeliner CRM: the former pipelinersales.com website redirects to Coevera, and the current homepage explicitly identifies the earlier brand. It is a B2B sales CRM organized around visual deal pipelines, account context and guided sales work. Voyager provides in-product AI assistance; Automatizer handles configured processes, and an MCP connection exposes CRM work to external AI assistants under a separate beta setup.

A useful evaluation starts with your actual pipeline stages, required records and sales-team permissions. The vendor currently targets teams of at least fifteen sellers in its standard pricing, with exceptions discussed through sales. This profile distinguishes migration preparation, workflow execution and AI access from broad claims about speed or cost savings. No account, migration, workflow or AI tool was tested for this catalog.
description_zh:
Coevera 是 Pipeliner CRM 的当前名称：原 pipelinersales.com 网站跳转到 Coevera，当前首页也明确标注原品牌。它是围绕可视化交易管线、账户背景和销售引导组织的 B2B CRM。Voyager 提供产品内 AI 辅助，Automatizer 执行配置流程；MCP 连接则通过单独的测试版设置向外部 AI 助手开放 CRM 工作。

评估应从真实管线阶段、必需记录及销售团队权限开始。当前标准定价面向至少15名销售人员的团队，例外需向销售讨论。本文区分迁移准备、工作流执行和 AI 访问，不把速度或节省成本宣传当实测结果；没有实际测试账户、迁移、工作流或 AI 工具。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Make the stage mean a completed business condition
sections.title_zh: 让阶段表示已完成的业务条件
sections.en:
The current product describes drag-and-drop pipeline stages and Kanban, list, chart, bubble and map views. For an illustrative B2B sale, define what qualification, proposal and commercial review mean, then attach an owner and next activity. These stage names are examples, not mandatory defaults.

A view helps a manager inspect work; it does not establish that an opportunity was qualified accurately or that the next action happened. Test a deal with incomplete information and a restricted user role, not only a complete administrator sample. Adoption speed, implementation time and reduced cost on the homepage remain vendor claims without a benchmark from this research.
sections.zh:
当前产品描述拖动管线阶段及看板、列表、图表、气泡和地图视图。以假设 B2B 销售为例，先定义资格判断、提案和商务复核的含义，再指定负责人和下一活动。这些阶段名只是示例，不是强制默认值。

视图帮助经理检查工作，但不能证明机会资格判断正确或下一动作已经完成。应测试信息不全的交易及权限受限用户，而不只使用管理员完整样例。首页的采用速度、实施时间及成本降低仍属厂商声明，本文未作基准验证。

sections.title_en: Reconcile actual values, not just imported record counts
sections.title_zh: 核对实际字段值，而非只看导入数量
sections.en:
Coevera's migration blueprint distinguishes structurally valid rows from valid target values. It reports that dropdown values without matching target options can leave a field empty despite an imported record. That is a vendor-authored case, not a failure reproduced in this catalog. Its useful operational lesson is to inventory the full source export and compare value sets before import.

For evaluation, include an unknown dropdown option, a casing variation, a shared email address and a record with a different owner. Check identity, ownership, required flags and value completeness after importing. Preserve source provenance and agree which fields are deliberately omitted. A small recent sample may miss older cohorts of data; a completed migration job is not by itself an acceptance test.
sections.zh:
Coevera 迁移蓝图区分结构有效的行和目标字段值有效。它报告：目标选项不存在时，下拉字段可能为空，而记录仍已导入。这是厂商撰写案例，不是本目录复现的故障。可借鉴的操作要点是盘点完整来源导出，并在导入前比较值集合。

评估建议包含未知下拉项、大小写变体、共用邮箱和不同负责人的记录。导入后检查身份、归属、必需标记及值完整性，保留来源记录，并约定哪些字段明确放弃。较小的近期样例可能漏掉旧数据群体，迁移任务完成本身不构成验收。

sections.title_en: Inspect warnings as well as errors
sections.en:
Automatizer's help page describes processes containing triggers, if/then conditions and actions. The Process Manager exposes active/inactive status and test/live execution logs. Process ownership affects editing and notifications, so designate an accountable maintainer rather than leaving automation under an unavailable user's account.

The documentation distinguishes warnings from errors: missing email authorization, unavailable personalization fields and failed related-record updates can be warnings; inaccessible/deleted fields or insufficient record permissions can be errors. It also describes a Stop notification after the last twenty executions ended with errors. Do not assume a quiet inbox means healthy execution, since repeated notifications are throttled. Inspect the actual run and affected record before retrying; no live failure was reproduced here.
sections.zh:
Automatizer 帮助页描述流程由触发器、if／then 条件和动作组成。Process Manager 显示启用／停用状态，以及测试／正式执行日志。流程归属影响编辑和通知，因此应指定能持续负责的维护者，避免依赖已无法联系的账户。

文档区分警告和错误：邮箱授权缺失、个性化字段不可用及关联记录更新失败可能是警告；字段不可访问／被删或记录权限不足可能是错误。它还说明最近20次执行均出错时的 Stop 通知。重复通知会限频，因此邮件安静不表示执行正常。重试前应检查实际执行和受影响记录；本文未复现线上故障。

sections.title_en: Voyager and external MCP clients are different paths
sections.title_zh: Voyager 与外部 MCP 客户端是不同路径
sections.en:
Voyager provides assistance inside Coevera. The price table distinguishes Voyager 1 from Voyager 2, with a resetting allowance, paid use beyond it and administrator spending caps. The public-beta MCP server instead lets an approved external client access live CRM data. It requires an admin request, vendor activation and user consent.

The MCP page says tools declare read/change/delete behavior and inherit authenticated-user permissions. Treat that as the documented access model, not independent proof that every client enforces the intended confirmation. Begin with scoped read access and verify an actual permission boundary before contemplating changes. A generated recommendation is not a verified customer fact, and no AI or authorization behavior was tested.
sections.zh:
Voyager 在 Coevera 内提供辅助。价格表区分 Voyager 1 和 Voyager 2，后者说明会重置的额度、超额付费及管理员支出上限。公开测试版 MCP 服务器则让获准的外部客户端访问实时 CRM 数据，需要管理员申请、厂商激活及用户授权。

MCP 页说明工具标明读／改／删行为，并继承登录用户权限。这是文档访问模型，不是每个客户端都会执行所需确认的独立证明。评估建议从限定只读范围开始，在考虑改动前核对真实权限边界。生成建议不等于已核实客户事实；本文未测试 AI 或授权行为。

sections.title_en: Budget the annual team commitment and scoped extras
sections.title_zh: 预算年度团队承诺及明确附加项
sections.en:
The current pricing page lists Business at $85, Enterprise at $115 and Unlimited at $150 per user/month billed annually, normally with at least fifteen users. Fifteen Business users illustrate 15 × 85 × 12 = $15,300 for a year before any unconfirmed extras or tax. The vendor invites smaller teams with an expansion case to discuss an exception; that is not a published unconditional one-seat offer.

The help page calls Automatizer a paid add-on, while the pricing table and AI usage terms must determine the contracted package. Confirm workflow inclusion, AI credits, migration scope, support, integrations and renewal together. This managed B2B CRM merits evaluation for a sales organization that can define its process and own data quality; exact license, data region, API limits, export coverage, UI languages and regional purchasing remain unverified. No implementation, subscription or claimed savings was measured.
sections.zh:
当前定价页列出 Business 每用户每月85美元、Enterprise 115美元、Unlimited 150美元，按年付款，通常至少15用户。以15个 Business 用户计算，一年为15 × 85 × 12 = 15,300美元，未含尚未确认的附加项或税。厂商邀请有扩张计划的小团队讨论例外，这不是公开无条件的单席位方案。

帮助页称 Automatizer 为付费附加项，最终合同组合还应结合定价表和 AI 用量条款确定。应一起确认工作流、AI 积分、迁移范围、支持、集成及续订。能定义销售流程并负责数据质量的 B2B 组织可进一步评估，但准确许可、数据地区、API 限制、导出覆盖、界面语言和地区购买仍未核实。本文未测量实施、订阅或宣传节省。
